artworks.title: Muckross Abbey, Killarney
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level view of a rustic, overgrown church ruin. A large, gnarled tree with numerous branches is on the left, surrounded by lush foliage that partially covers the stone structures. The dense vegetation obscures the horizon, and the tall, ancient walls of the building dominate the scene. The closest structure has an arched doorway and a pair of narrow windows above it, with its stone surface covered in creeping vines. The color palette is a sepia tone, giving the photograph a nostalgic quality. Light and shadow play across the scene, emphasizing the textures of the stone and vegetation.

artworks.title: Portrait of Two Children
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of two young children, with their upper bodies and torsos visible. The child on the left has short, curly hair and wears a coat with light-colored fur trim, holding a hat with a wide brim and plume. The child on the right has medium-length, straight hair and wears a dress with puffed sleeves. Both children have neutral expressions. The background is plain and dark, and the portrait is framed with an ornate border with a gold and red design.

artworks.title: Landscape Study
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro

artworks.title: Tullichewan Castle, Vale of Leven, Scotland
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a stone castle with rounded towers and ivy-covered walls. The castle is captured from a slightly lower angle, showcasing its towering presence and architectural details. The horizon is hidden by the castle and surrounding trees, creating an intimate atmosphere. The image is in sepia tone, giving it an antique look. The color scheme is limited to shades of brown and beige, enhancing the historical ambiance and highlighting textures. A stone wall covered in foliage extends from the castle to the right, where a figure is seated. Trees on the right frame the scene, with their leaves contrasting the castle's stonework.

artworks.title: Tullichewan Castle, Vale of Leven, Scotland
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a wide perspective of a scene from slightly above ground level. Large trees obscure the horizon, with the base of a castle roughly in the middle. Two men are conversing on a grassy area in the foreground. A dense leafy tree dominates the left side, while a castle with a round tower rises above the trees in the distance. The sky is overcast with clouds in the background, and the overall image has a sepia-toned palette.

artworks.title: Segovia, Façade of the Alcazar and Moorish Tower
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a large castle with detailed architecture. The horizon is blurry, highlighting the castle's stone structure. The castle features a tower with battlements, turrets, and conical roofs with cross-like spires. Nearby are trees and a stone balustrade. The monochrome palette accentuates the stonework's texture and details.

artworks.title: The Village Stile
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro

artworks.title: Tree Study
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows a dense wooded area with a gnarled tree in the foreground, surrounded by thick foliage including ferns and other smaller trees. The tree's bark and leaves show detailed textures. The color palette is mostly monochromatic with a sepia tone conveying a vintage feel. More trees can be seen in the distance, blending their trunks and canopies into the background, creating depth in the scene.

artworks.title: The Echo Rock, Fountains Abbey
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a frontal view of a rock formation dominating the upper half of the frame. Two men in formal attire are seated and standing against the rock, set against a background of more rocks and vegetation. The color palette is a monochromatic sepia tone, giving the scene a vintage and timeless quality.

artworks.title: Salerno, Italy
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal landscape from an elevated position. The horizon is visible with a shore and a town nestled against hills and mountains. A collection of light-colored buildings stretches along the shoreline. The hillside slopes down towards the shore, which has a gentle curve. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. The scene captures the interface of land and sea, with calm waters extending beyond the shoreline.

artworks.title: Chateau de Josselin, Burgundy
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a stone castle across a river viewed from a grassy riverbank. The castle has conical-roofed towers against a pale sky. The color palette is sepia with a warm, vintage look. In the foreground, there are some blurred trees on the left. Moored sailing vessels can be seen along the riverbank near the castle.

artworks.title: Parc de Hamilton Palace (Parasol Pine)
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large tree with sprawling branches against a vast sky. A fence surrounds the tree's base, and there are other trees in the background. The photo is in black and white, emphasizing contrast.

artworks.title: Steam Engine near the Grand Transept, Crystal Palace
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an industrial scene inside a large construction site. The image shows a partially constructed building supported by metal beams and scaffolding. The interior is covered in construction materials, with piles of lumber and debris scattered across the ground. Central to the image is heavy machinery, with steam rising from it. The environment is busy with intersecting lines of the scaffolding and beams, showcasing the complexity of the construction work involved. The sepia tones suggest an early 20th-century setting.

artworks.title: The Picnic Party
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: Three women are sitting side by side under an ancient stone arch. The woman on the left is in profile, with her hair pulled back. The woman in the middle faces forward, holding an object on her lap. The woman on the right is turned slightly away. They are dressed in long skirts and dark blouses with additional fabric. Near them are a basket and a box. They sit on a stone bench with a stone archway behind them. A dog is laying on the ground in front of them.

artworks.title: Pyramids of Sakkarah & Gizeh, from above
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Charles T. Isaacs
artworks.description: The image shows a desert landscape with sand dunes seen from an elevated point. The terrain is covered with sand formations, some showing darker spots. In the distance, the horizon is high in the frame, with small pyramid shapes visible on it. The texture resembles vintage photography, capturing the sand's undulations. The color palette features sepia tones, giving a warm and nostalgic feel, and the sky above is clear with minimal clouds.

artworks.title: Flowers
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation

artworks.title: Thèbes, Medinet Habou, Galeries du Palais (Palace Galleries at Medinet Habou, Thebes)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an architectural interior with ancient columns. The photograph shows a row of massive stone columns, each intricately carved with hieroglyphics and reliefs. The columns are aligned in a row, leading the eye down the corridor they form. The play of light and shadow across the columns and the floor enhances the grandeur and mystery of the space. The texture and patterns of the carvings are clearly visible, and the scale of the columns is emphasized by the contrasting background of darker shadows.

artworks.title: Banks of a Pool, the Rumbling Bridge at Dunkeld
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows a view from above, looking down into a narrow gorge or chasm. Massive rock walls are visible on either side, with the rugged texture of their surfaces providing a stark contrast to the smoothness of the water's surface below. The horizon is not visible as the scene is enclosed by the towering cliffs. The photograph is rendered in a monochromatic sepia tone, emphasizing the play of light and shadow across the rock faces. The dark areas within the chasm beyond create a sense of depth and mystery.

artworks.title: Misses Laura, Emily, Eva, and Edith
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of four young women and girls. Three of them are standing, while one is seated. Two of the standing women are positioned on either side, while the third is seated on the left, facing slightly downward and holding an open book. The young girl is seated on the floor in front. All four have their hair parted in the middle and styled straight or tucked behind their ears. Their faces have calm expressions. They are wearing long-sleeved dresses with full skirts typical of the 19th century, featuring buttons or decorative stripes across the bodice. The dresses vary slightly in design but are similar in style. The background is a plain, neutral backdrop.

artworks.title: Stonehenge
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro Ph.D
artworks.description: The image shows large stone formations in various orientations, with some upright and others placed horizontally. The horizon is low in the frame, mostly hidden by the stones. The picture is in sepia tone with a contrast between the stones and the sky. The stones have rough textures, indicating age and natural erosion.

artworks.title: English Country Cottage
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an old house with a combination of brick and timber construction. The house has a steeply slanted roof with shingles, and its facade is partly covered by shrubs. There are windows with traditional leaded designs visible. The surrounding area is lush with greenery, extending into the distance. A wooden structure is present on a dirt path nearby. The colors in the image are primarily sepia and gray, giving it a nostalgic feel. The trees and foliage have a soft and slightly diffused focus.

artworks.title: Brimham Rocks, Yorkshire
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro

artworks.title: Dalegarth Force, Cumberland
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro

artworks.title: The Pyramids of El-Geezeh, from the South-West
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a desert landscape with the pyramids of Giza. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, facing the three prominent pyramids. The horizon is high above the pyramids, with a vast sky without distinct markings or clouds. In the foreground, there are small pebbles and rocks, with two figures and a horse. The sand extends towards the pyramids, showing detailed stone blocks in gradual layers. The color palette is sepia, creating a vintage appearance with light and shadow play.
